headline: AlphaGenome Atlas turns genome-wide variant-effect inference into a precomputed 9-billion-variant research resource
summary: Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome Atlas on 2026-09-08 as a roughly 1 PB catalogue containing AlphaGenome-derived molecular-effect predictions for more than 9 billion possible single-nucleotide substitutions across the human reference genome, alongside the new AlphaGenome Variant Impact score and interpretable feature contributions. The underlying AlphaGenome model is peer-reviewed and strong across many variant-effect benchmarks, while independent 2026 evaluations show that performance varies materially by cell context and haplotype background. Atlas therefore represents a major scientific-infrastructure change in search economics, not experimental measurement of every variant.
